proposition: Every labelled graph on 6 vertices in which every vertex has degree at least 2 is connected.
quantifiers: for all graphs G on exactly 6 labelled vertices

argument.text: At least one graph on 6 vertices has minimum degree at least 2, so the statement is not vacuous.
If every vertex has degree at least 2 then every connected component contains at least 3 vertices.
A graph on 6 vertices in which every component has at least 3 vertices is connected.
Every graph on 6 vertices either has minimum degree at least 2 or it does not.
The graph at index 1 of the enumeration has exactly one edge; it is checked directly.
Handshake lemma: in every graph on 6 vertices the sum of the degrees is even.
Every graph on 6 vertices with minimum degree at least 2 has at least 6 edges.
Combining the two implications gives the statement for all 32768 labelled graphs on 6 vertices.
